verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a `webhook-id` header on every webhook, intended as an idempotency key for deduplicating retried deliveries. It also documents webhook signing, enabled per account, so developers can verify that events are authentic. missing for 10: details of the signature scheme and verification procedure (algorithm, header names, secret handling), explicit retry/redelivery policy documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications

citations.quote: Every webhook we send carries a `webhook-id` header... Use it as your idempotency key.
Webhook signing is opt-in per account.
